Hi Sergio,

I’m really sorry — I woke up this morning with a fever and I’m not in great shape to do a 45-minute live coding session. I can still do the 11:00 behavioral call if that works, but for the technical piece I’d prefer to either:

- do the take-home prompt and send a recorded screen-share walkthrough (Loom/recorded terminal) by EOD, or
- reschedule the technical live portion to next week (I’m available Tue/Wed morning PT)

I’m happy to be flexible — I don’t want to waste anyone’s time on a low-quality live session. Sorry for the last-minute change.

Thanks for understanding,

Subject: RE: Interview for Frontend Engineer — candidate ill day, proposed split plan

Team,

Heads up — Jordan just messaged that they’re sick this morning (fever). They offered to keep the 11:00 behavior call and submit a recorded walkthrough of the coding prompt by EOD, or we can reschedule the technical interview next week.

Proposal to keep momentum for Acme:
- Move forward with a 20–25 min behavioral sync at 11:00 PT with Lauren (no change).
- For the 10:00 technical slot: either (A) convert to a short live technical check-in (20 mins) focused on architecture and past work (no whiteboard), followed by Jordan sending the recorded coding walkthrough by EOD; OR (B) postpone the full live coding to next week.

Can you confirm quickly which you prefer? If nobody can do a later reschedule, I can convert 10:00 to option A and treat the recording as the main artifact to evaluate coding approach.

I’ve copied Amit (hiring manager) so he’s aware. Jordan — quick question: if you do the recording, does EOD today work? Also, would you prefer Loom or a recorded screen-share zip?

Thanks — Sergio
[Attachment: takehome-instructions.pdf referenced above]

Thanks for the heads up. I’m fine keeping the 11:00 behavioral loop — I’ll shorten it to ~20 minutes to be mindful of Jordan’s bandwidth. I can also take a 20-minute technical chat at 10:00 focused on high-level architecture (option A) if Monica is ok not running a full coding session.

If Jordan can send a Loom by EOD, that works for me as the primary coding artifact. If the recording doesn’t arrive, we should give the candidate the option to reschedule the live coding.

—Lauren
